verdict.rationale: DeepSeek is an LLM API platform, and such a platform could plausibly offer event-triggered automation rules, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no rules engine, event triggers, or automatic actions. Function calling and the Harness developer preview are model or agent building blocks, not user-defined event-to-action rules, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
